# HowToPronounce.com

> > A crowdsourced multilingual pronunciation dictionary with audio guides, IPA transcriptions, and embeddable pronunciation players for words, names, and phrases across multiple languages.

HowToPronounce.com provides user-contributed audio pronunciations and phonetic spellings using the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA). The platform supports multiple languages including English and German, offering embeddable widgets for pronunciation learning and reference.

## Key Topics

- Audio pronunciation
- IPA (International Phonetic Alphabet)
- Pronunciation guide
- Phonetic spelling
- Language learning
- Name pronunciation
- Multilingual dictionary
- German language interface
- English pronunciation
- Embedded pronunciation player
- User-contributed audio
- IPA transcription
- Crowdsourced dictionary

## Main Platform

- [How To Pronounce: Online Multilingual Pronunciation Dictionary](https://howtopronounce.com): Homepage: crowdsourced multilingual pronunciation dictionary
